notes:
TOKYO: confirmed absent. Tower's own offices page (https://tower-research.com/offices/) lists exactly 15 offices — New York (x2), London, Gurugram, Singapore, Amsterdam, Charleston, Chicago, Dubai, George Town, GIFT City, Hong Kong, Montreal, Paris, Shanghai. There is no Tokyo office and no Japan entity. The one Japan-facing role, 'ETF Trader' covering Japan and Hong Kong ETF flows, is based in Singapore. Any Tower Tokyo row is fabricated and should be deleted.

SOURCE AND METHOD: Tower's /open-positions/ page is a JavaScript Greenhouse embed that renders nothing to a plain fetch, and both boards.greenhouse.io/towerresearchcapital and job-boards.greenhouse.io/towerresearchcapital 301/302 back to tower-research.com. I enumerated the board through Tower's own Greenhouse board API (https://boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/towerresearchcapital/jobs?content=true), which returned all 74 live requisitions with full posting text. Every role above was read from that primary posting text; the URLs given are the canonical tower-research.com apply links.

DUPLICATE REQUISITIONS: Tower posts several multi-city reqs under one job id. gh_jid 4986715 covers London/Paris/Amsterdam, 4958633 covers Hong Kong/Shanghai/Singapore/Sydney, 6346539 covers Singapore/Hong Kong/Shanghai, and 6296510 covers Hong Kong/Shanghai. I expanded these into one row per in-scope city, so the same URL appears more than once — that is deliberate, not a duplication error. The Machine Learning Engineer and Systems Engineer roles, by contrast, have genuinely separate per-city requisitions.

EXISTING-ROW CORRECTION, SENIORITY: every existing spreadsheet row asserted 'New-grad OR entry-level req — recent grads accepted'. That is wrong across the board. Tower's in-scope engineering reqs mostly carry hard experience floors — 5+ years (Software Engineer C++, all APAC offices), 5-7 years (Software Engineer C++, London), 7+ years (Senior SWE Development Tools, London), 10+ years (Core Engineering Manager, Singapore). The reqs that genuinely have no seniority floor are the London Quantitative Developer C++, the Singapore Software Developer, the Machine Learning Engineer family (2+ years), the Hong Kong/Shanghai Quantitative Developer C++ (1-5 years), and the trader/researcher reqs.

NO COMPENSATION DATA: no in-scope posting states a salary. The only figure anywhere on Tower's board is '$150,000-$250,000 base plus bonus' on the New York/Chicago Experienced Quantitative Trader req, which is out of scope. Every comp_local field is therefore empty; the £/€/SGD/HKD bands in the existing spreadsheet are not sourced from Tower and should be treated as unverified estimates.

BORDERLINE ROLES EXCLUDED FROM THE LIST: 'Quantitative Developer, Python - Trading Teams EMEA' London (gh_jid=7080219) and 'Quantitative Developer' Singapore (gh_jid=5733830) are Python-only research-tooling seats (Numpy/Pandas/Polars, 2+ years Python) — adjacent and worth an application, but they fit none of the four tracks cleanly so I left them out rather than mislabel the track. Also excluded: Network Engineer (Hong Kong gh_jid=8027865, Singapore gh_jid=8027690, pure network operations), Reliability Engineer (Singapore/Hong Kong, gh_jid=8000035 and 8000037, 5+ years, L1/L2 production support), 'Software Engineer' Singapore (gh_jid=7613150, internal tooling/automation), 'Trading Systems Support Analyst' London (gh_jid=7722018, support), and 'Business Analytics Intern' Amsterdam (gh_jid=8041512, internship). 'Experienced Quantitative Trader' (gh_jid=16619) is tagged 'Multiple Locations' without naming cities and requires an existing consistently profitable strategy with a live track record — a portfolio-manager seat, not applicable.

COVERAGE GAP: Tower's federated model means individual trading teams hire off-cycle and not every seat reaches the public board. The board API is the complete public picture as of 2026-08-04, but a targeted approach to EMEA or APAC recruiting may surface unlisted desk-level roles.
